onboarding.step1_desc: Select the language you want to use the app in
onboarding.translate_prompt: Do you want to change content according to your language?

business.header_desc: We'll start with the essential business details to ensure everything is legally compliant and ready for your first sale.
business.chat_msg: Hi! I'm here to help you get set up. This first step ensures your store operates legally and connects smoothly to payout systems. Reach out if you get stuck!
business.consistency_desc: Make sure your Legal Business Name matches exactly what is on your bank statements to avoid delays in verifying your payout account later.

identity.title: Store Identity
identity.subtitle: Shape how customers experience your brand. Add your visuals and colors to make your storefront unmistakably yours.
identity.upload_prompt: Click to upload or drag and drop
identity.logo_desc: Used as your avatar on receipts and the directory. 512 x 512px recommended.
identity.theme_desc: Select a primary color that matches your brand identity.
identity.desc_subtitle: Tell customers what makes your business unique.
identity.desc_placeholder: e.g., We are a family-owned bakery specializing in artisanal sourdough and hand-crafted pastries, serving the neighborhood since 2015.
identity.preview_desc_placeholder: Your store description will appear here...
identity.preview_footer: This is how your storefront will appear to customers on the Bazaar app.

location.title: Pinpoint Your Bazaar
location.subtitle: Let customers know exactly where to find you. Set your storefront location and define your delivery radius to see your potential reach.
location.search_placeholder: Type address and hit Enter to search...

catalog.title: Stock Your Shelves
catalog.subtitle: Adding products doesn't have to be tedious. Use our AI tools to instantly build your catalog, or do it the old-fashioned way.
catalog.voice_desc: Just list items out loud, our AI does the rest.
catalog.snap_desc: Take a photo of your menu or shelf to extract.
catalog.manual_desc: Create products one by one with precision.
catalog.empty_desc: Choose an option on the left to start adding products to your digital storefront.
catalog.alert_ingestion: The {type} ingestion feature is currently being powered up by our AI backend! For now, please use Add Manually.
catalog.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to remove this product?

payments.title: Get Paid. Securely.
payments.subtitle: Connect your bank account and UPI to receive seamless, automated daily payouts for your sales. Your data is encrypted and secure.
payments.fast_desc: Link your UPI for direct transfers

staff.title: Assemble Your Team
staff.subtitle: Don't run the store alone! Invite managers, cashiers, and delivery partners. They'll receive an SMS to download the app and join your store.
staff.name: Full Name *
staff.empty_desc: Send an invite using the form to add staff to your store.
